latest_action: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR H6273)
title_official: To direct the Secretary of Education, in consultation with the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, to establish a demonstration program to increase the postsecondary attainment of students who are experiencing homelessness or at risk of experiencing homelessness through housing assistance and supportive services, and for other purposes.
